VISTA.Settings: Vista: Theater of the Mind Settings
VISTA.EnableStripsHint: When enabled, this scene uses abstract strips instead of a battle map.
VISTA.StripCountHint: How many horizontal strips to divide the scene into (1 to 4).
VISTA.StripLabelsHint: Optional labels for each strip, e.g. 'Bar, Common Room, Stage'.
VISTA.SortByInitiativeHint: When combat is active, sort tokens by initiative instead of name.
